notes: P03 deliverable PST-X04_encrypted_ref (ReceiptMin RQ2 comparator mechanism, B2 arm): evaluation/venue2027/pst/encrypted_full_log.py implements the strong confidentiality baseline with authenticated encryption (AES-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305), strict nonce discipline, role-based access control ACL, periodic key rotation, explicit retention expiration, and compare_audit_vs_leakage. (1) AUTHENTICATED ENCRYPTION: standard AES-GCM (RFC 5116 / NIST SP 800-38D) and ChaCha20-Poly1305 (RFC 8439) guarantee confidentiality and integrity; tampered ciphertext, auth tag, or AAD fail closed with AUTH_TAG_FAILED. (2) STRICT NONCE DISCIPLINE: unique 12-byte nonces; NonceTracker detects nonce reuse per key and fails closed with NONCE_REUSED. (3) ACCESS CONTROL: role ACL enforced on decrypt_audit_record; unauthorized roles denied with UNAUTHORIZED_ROLE. (4) KEY ROTATION: KeyRing manages key lifecycle, rotation, and crypto-shredding (KEY_DESTROYED); reencrypt_record enables record migration under fresh epoch keys without plaintext disclosure. (5) RETENTION EXPIRATION: decryption past expires_at is refused with RETENTION_EXPIRED. (6) COMPARATOR: compare_audit_vs_leakage demonstrates that while legitimate audits achieve 1.0 reconstruction, an insider with a compromised key recovers 100% of sensitive payload and linkability, establishing the scientific need for B4 ReceiptMin.
